messages:
Ana: quick q — thinking about adding conditional 'Need help?' inline hints in the Private setup stepper (network step). Should we show them collapsed by default or always visible? screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/stepper-help.png
Matt: leaning collapsed + a small 'Show troubleshooting' toggle. reduces noise for power users but still discoverable. :bulb:
Laura: accessibility note — if collapsed, toggle must be keyboard focusable and have aria-expanded + aria-controls. probe status updates should be read via an aria-live region when visible.
Suresh: impl note — collapsed content is trivial, but live updates inside a hidden container are tricky. we should move the live region out or only attach updates after expansion to avoid missed announcements.
Ana: good catch. copywise: draft microcopy — `Can't reach your host? Try these quick checks: firewall, CIDR, outgoing SSH (port 22).` ok or too terse?
Matt: wording tweak: "outgoing SSH (port 22)" is clearer than 'SSH egress'. also add a secondary link 'Show me how' that opens a small help drawer with commands and diagrams.
Laura: also don't rely on color for status pills — use icons + sr-only text. ensure contrast for the toggle and the pill backgrounds.
Suresh: perf angle — lazy-load probe logs and heavy telemetry only when the panel is expanded. we can prefetch on hover for snappy UX.
Ana: proposed plan: collapsed by default, auto-expand for first-run (persist via cookie), remember manual toggle per user. update microcopy per Matt. can one of you mock up copy + aria notes for handoff?
Matt: will add quick mock and updated copy in Figma and post link (ETA today).
Laura: I'll compile an a11y checklist (focus order, aria-expanded, aria-controls, live region placement, non-color indicators). ping me when Figma link is up.
